purpose: M8-B: an analysis with a requirement a resume cannot show (work authorisation, not_evident) beside two real gaps. The interviewer asks about it and the candidate answers it plainly. The debrief must not turn it into a gap row (gapFollowThrough has the two gaps only), must treat the answer as evidence, and must score the two gaps on what was said.

context.jobDescription: Orbit Telecom is hiring a Customer Support Team Lead in Dublin. You will lead a team of eight agents across phone, chat and email. Required: two or more years leading a support team of at least five people; Zendesk or a comparable helpdesk tool, well enough to build views and macros; you must be legally authorised to work in Ireland, as we cannot sponsor work permits. A background in telecommunications would help but is not essential.
context.analysisSummary: Team leadership is met with three years leading eight agents. Zendesk is only partly shown: the resume names it but not views or macros. Telecommunications is missing; the background is utilities and retail. Work authorisation is not something a resume shows.

requirements.requirement: Two or more years leading a support team of at least five people
requirements.evidence: Support team lead with three years running an eight-person phone and email team for a utility

requirements.requirement: Zendesk or a comparable helpdesk tool, well enough to build views and macros
requirements.note: Zendesk is named, but nothing shows building views or macros.

requirements.requirement: Legally authorised to work in Ireland

gapOutcomes.why: Built the views and macros herself, names them, says what they changed.
No telecom employer, but billing and outage queues at a utility are close; partially is the honest reading.

mustNotMatch.why: Work authorisation was not_evident, not a gap: it must not get a gap row.

mustMatch.why: She answered the condition plainly; the debrief should treat that answer as evidence somewhere.

maxViolations.why: Every quote must be a verbatim span of a candidate turn.
No number the candidate or the posting did not say.
No technology the candidate or the posting did not name.
